title: Each round is for something different, so brief for each
takeaway: Early rounds clear a floor and late rounds test judgement; one tip per round avoids preparing for all of them the same way.
sources: Early rounds are about clearing a floor, quickly.
Preparing for them the same way wastes time on both.
An interviewer cannot give credit for reasoning they cannot hear.
